verses.sloka: हत्वा तु तम् भीम बलम् विराधम् राक्षसम् वने ।ततः सीताम् परिष्वज्य समाश्वास्य च वीर्यवान् ॥३-५-१॥
verses.transliteration: hatvā tu tam bhīma balam virādham rākṣasam vane ।tataḥ sītām pariṣvajya samāśvāsya ca vīryavān ॥3-5-1॥

translations.english: On killing Viradha, the demon of terrific strength, heroic Rama embraced Sita, consoled her and said to his brother Lakshmana, glowing like fire:
translations.hindi: अरण्यकाएड का चौथा सर्गे पूरा हुआ । पञ्चमः सग; ऱ्प्य्म B— हत्वा तु तं भीमबलं विराधं राक्षसं वने । ततः सीतां परिष्वज्य समाश्वास्य च वीर्यवान्‌

verses.sloka: अब्रवीत् भ्रातरम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् दीप्त तेजसम् ।कष्टम् वनम् इदम् दुर्गम् न च स्मो वन गोचराः ॥३-५-२॥
verses.transliteration: abravīt bhrātaram rāmo lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam ।kaṣṭam vanam idam durgam na ca smo vana gocarāḥ ॥3-5-2॥

translations.english: This wild forest with which we have not been acquainted earlier is difficult to pass. (Hence) let us proceed quickly to sage Sarabhanga.
translations.hindi: ओर अपने तेजरंबी भाई “लक्ष्मण से बोले--यह वन बडा ` दुगेम और कष्टदायी है। हम लोगों ने ऐसा विकट वन इसके पूदे कभी नहीं देखा था

verses.sloka: अभिगच्छामहे शीघ्रम् शरभङ्गम् तपो धनम् ।आश्रमम् शरभन्गस्य राघवोऽभिजगाम ह ॥३-५-३॥
verses.transliteration: abhigacchāmahe śīghram śarabhaṅgam tapo dhanam ।āśramam śarabhangasya rāghavo'bhijagāma ha ॥3-5-3॥

translations.english: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

verses.sloka: तस्य देव प्रभावस्य तपसा भावित आत्मनः ।समीपे शरभंगस्य ददर्श महत् अद्भुतम् ॥३-५-४॥
verses.transliteration: tasya deva prabhāvasya tapasā bhāvita ātmanaḥ ।samīpe śarabhaṁgasya dadarśa mahat adbhutam ॥3-5-4॥

translations.english: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.
translations.hindi: बहाँ पहुँच कर. उन देवतुल्य प्रभाववाले और तपस्या द्वारा ब्रह्म का साक्षात्कार किए हुए शरभङ्ग के आश्रम में एक बड़ा चमत्कार देखा

verses.sloka: विभ्राजमानम् वपुषा सूर्य वैश्वानर प्रभम् ।रथ प्रवरम् आरूढम् आकाशे विबुध अनुगम् ॥३-५-५॥
verses.transliteration: vibhrājamānam vapuṣā sūrya vaiśvānara prabham ।ratha pravaram ārūḍham ākāśe vibudha anugam ॥3-5-5॥

translations.english: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.
translations.hindi: ¦ देखा कि सूयं और अभि के समान प्रकाशमान, देवराज इन्द्र अपने शारीर की प्रभा से प्रकाशित हो, देवताओं के साथ श्रेष्ठ रथ पर चढ़े हुए हैं

verses.sloka: असंस्पृशन्तम् वसुधाम् ददर्श विबुध ईश्वरम् ।संप्रभ आभरणम् देवम् विरजो अंबर धारिणम् ॥३-५-६॥
verses.transliteration: asaṁspṛśantam vasudhām dadarśa vibudha īśvaram ।saṁprabha ābharaṇam devam virajo aṁbara dhāriṇam ॥3-5-6॥

translations.english: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.
translations.hindi: श्याम रंग के घोड़ों से युक्त उनका रथ प्रथिडी का स्पर्श न कर आकाश में चलता था, उनके सभ आभूषण चमक रहे थे ओर पहिनने के वस्त्र भी उजले थे (सफेद)

verses.sloka: तत् विधैः एव बहुभिर् पूज्यमानम् महात्मभिः ।हरितैः वाजिभिर् युक्तम् अंतरिक्ष गतम् रथम् ॥३-५-७॥
verses.transliteration: tat vidhaiḥ eva bahubhir pūjyamānam mahātmabhiḥ ।haritaiḥ vājibhir yuktam aṁtarikṣa gatam ratham ॥3-5-7॥

translations.english: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने दर से देखा कि, उनके मस्तक पर तरुण सूर्य ( मध्याह्न के सयं ) के समान अथवा सफेद मेघ के तुल्य व्प़रथवा चन्द्रमण्डल के सद्रश विमल छत्र, जो “चित्र विचित्र मालाओं से सुशोभित था, लगा हुआ है। उनके आगे सोने की डंडी के और मूल्यवान चवर और पंखा लिये हुए दो सुन्ःरी स्त्रियां उन्हें उनके मस्तक पर डुल रही थीं | बहुत से देख गन्मवे ओर सिद्ध और देवर्षिश्रेष्ठ उनका स्तुति-पाठ करते जाते थे । उस समय इन्द्र शरभङ्ग जी से कुछ वात्ताज्ञाप कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: ददर्श अदूरतः तस्य तरुण आदित्य संनिभम् ।पाण्डुर अभ्र घन प्रख्यम् चन्द्र मण्डल संनिभम् ॥३-५-८॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa adūrataḥ tasya taruṇa āditya saṁnibham ।pāṇḍura abhra ghana prakhyam candra maṇḍala saṁnibham ॥3-5-8॥

translations.english: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

verses.sloka: अपश्यत् विमलम् छत्रम् चित्र माल्य उपशोभितम् ।चामर व्यजने च अग्र्ये रुक्म दण्डे महाधने ॥३-५-९॥
verses.transliteration: apaśyat vimalam chatram citra mālya upaśobhitam ।cāmara vyajane ca agrye rukma daṇḍe mahādhane ॥3-5-9॥

translations.english: Rama saw a pure white umbrella with a highly expensive golden staff, decorated with variegated flower garlands.While near his (Indra's) head stood a pair of exquisite ladies with fans made of yak's tail.

verses.sloka: गृहीते वर नारीभ्याम् धूयमाने च मूर्धनि ।गन्धर्व अमर सिद्धाः च बहवः परम ऋषयः ॥३-५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: gṛhīte vara nārībhyām dhūyamāne ca mūrdhani ।gandharva amara siddhāḥ ca bahavaḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ ॥3-5-10॥

translations.english: Many celestial singers of heaven, gods, great sages and siddhas sang with the choicest words the glory of this god stationed in the sky.

verses.sloka: अन्तरिक्ष गतम् देवम् गीर्भिर् अग्र्याभिर् ऐडियन् ।सह संभाषमाणे तु शरभंगेन वासवे ॥३-५-११॥
verses.transliteration: antarikṣa gatam devam gīrbhir agryābhir aiḍiyan ।saha saṁbhāṣamāṇe tu śarabhaṁgena vāsave ॥3-5-11॥

translations.english: While Indra was conversing with Sarabhanga, Rama saw him and said to Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा शत क्रतुम् तत्र रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ।रामोऽथ रथम् उद्दिश्य भ्रातुर् दर्शयत अद्भुतम् ॥३-५-१२॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śata kratum tatra rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt ।rāmo'tha ratham uddiśya bhrātur darśayata adbhutam ॥3-5-12॥

translations.english: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.
translations.hindi: वहाँ पर इन्द्र को देख, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने, लक्ष्मण, का ध्यान उस रथ की ओर आकषट कर लक्ष्मण से कहा

verses.sloka: अर्चिष्मन्तम् श्रिया जुष्टम् अद्भुतम् पश्य लक्ष्मण ।प्रतपन्तम् इव आदित्यम् अन्तरिक्ष गतम् रथम् ॥३-५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: arciṣmantam śriyā juṣṭam adbhutam paśya lakṣmaṇa ।pratapantam iva ādityam antarikṣa gatam ratham ॥3-5-13॥

translations.english: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! परम दीप्तिमान, कान्तियुक्त, तपते हुए सूर्य की तरह चमकीले इस अद्भुत एवं आकाशच।री रथ को देखो

verses.sloka: ये हयाः पुरु हूतस्य पुरा शक्रस्य नः श्रुताः ।अन्तरिक्ष गता दिव्याः ते इमे हरयो ध्रुवम् ॥३-५-१४॥
verses.transliteration: ye hayāḥ puru hūtasya purā śakrasya naḥ śrutāḥ ।antarikṣa gatā divyāḥ te ime harayo dhruvam ॥3-5-14॥

translations.english: The horses of Indra, who is often invoked (during sacrificial rituals) and about whom we have heard earlier, are now stationed in the sky.
translations.hindi: अनेक यज्ञ करने वाले इन्द्र के घोड़ों के विषय में मेंने जो पहले सुना था, सो निश्चय ही आकाशचारी श्याम रंग के दिव्य घोड़े ये ही हैं

verses.sloka: इमे च पुरुष व्याघ्र ये तिष्ठन्ति अभितः दिशम् ।शतम् शतम् कुण्डलिनो युवानः खड्ग पाणयः ॥३-५-१५॥
verses.transliteration: ime ca puruṣa vyāghra ye tiṣṭhanti abhitaḥ diśam ।śatam śatam kuṇḍalino yuvānaḥ khaḍga pāṇayaḥ ॥3-5-15॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

verses.sloka: विस्तीर्ण विपुल उरस्काः परिघायत बाहवः ।शोणांशु वसनाः सर्वे व्याघ्र इव दुरासदाः ॥३-५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: vistīrṇa vipula uraskāḥ parighāyata bāhavaḥ ।śoṇāṁśu vasanāḥ sarve vyāghra iva durāsadāḥ ॥3-5-16॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! जब तक में जाकर यह जान लूँ कि, यह बैठा हुआ द्युतिमान पुरुष कौन हे, तत्र तक तुम. मुहूर्त भर सीता जी के साथ यहीं खड़े रहो

verses.sloka: उरो देशेषु सर्वेषाम् हारा ज्वलन संनिभाः ।रूपम् बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पंच विंशति वार्षिकम् ॥३-५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: uro deśeṣu sarveṣām hārā jvalana saṁnibhāḥ ।rūpam bibhrati saumitre paṁca viṁśati vārṣikam ॥3-5-17॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

verses.sloka: एतद्धि किल देवानाम् वयो भवति नित्यदा ।यथा इमे पुरुष व्याघ्रा दृश्यन्ते प्रिय दर्शनाः ॥३-५-१८॥
verses.transliteration: etaddhi kila devānām vayo bhavati nityadā ।yathā ime puruṣa vyāghrā dṛśyante priya darśanāḥ ॥3-5-18॥

translations.english: These tigers among men have cheerful countenacess from which it can be deduced that the age of the gods always remains constant.
translations.hindi: र हे पुरुपसिंह ! देवताओं की उम्र और सौन्दर्य निश्चय ही सदा ऐसा ही बना रहता है, जैसे ये अब प्रियदर्शन देख पड़ते हें

verses.sloka: इह एव सह वैदेह्या मुहूर्तम् तिष्ठ लक्ष्मण ।यावत् जानामि अहम् व्यक्तम् क एष द्युतिमान् रथे ॥३-५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: iha eva saha vaidehyā muhūrtam tiṣṭha lakṣmaṇa ।yāvat jānāmi aham vyaktam ka eṣa dyutimān rathe ॥3-5-19॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, stay here with Sita awhile, until I ascertain who this dazzling being on the chariot is.

verses.sloka: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा सौमित्रिम् इह एव स्थीयताम् इति ।अभिचक्राम काकुत्स्थः शरभंग आश्रमम् प्रति ॥३-५-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tam evam uktvā saumitrim iha eva sthīyatām iti ।abhicakrāma kākutsthaḥ śarabhaṁga āśramam prati ॥3-5-20॥

translations.english: Instructing Lakshmana to wait , Rama went towards Sarabhanga's hermitage.

verses.sloka: ततः समभिगच्छन्तम् प्रेक्ष्य रामम् शची पतिः ।शरभंगम् अनुज्ञाप्य विबुधान् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-५-२१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samabhigacchantam prekṣya rāmam śacī patiḥ ।śarabhaṁgam anujñāpya vibudhān idam abravīt ॥3-5-21॥

translations.english: Then Indra (husband of Sachi) having seen Rama coming towards him, approached Sarabhanga and said this to him privately:
translations.hindi: शचीपति इन्द्र ने श्रीराम को आते देख, शरभंङ्ग सरे बिदा माँगी ओर देवताओं से गुप्त रीति से यह बोले

verses.sloka: इह उपयाति असौ रामो यावन् माम् न अभिभाषते ।निष्ठाम् नयत तावत् तु ततो मा द्रष्टुम् अर्हति ॥३-५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: iha upayāti asau rāmo yāvan mām na abhibhāṣate ।niṣṭhām nayata tāvat tu tato mā draṣṭum arhati ॥3-5-22॥

translations.english: Here comes Rama. Before he talks to me, take me to some other place from where he may not be able to see me. He has to do a great task which is difficult for others. I can see him when he accomplishes the taste and emerges victorious.
translations.hindi: देखो श्रीरामचन्द्र इधर ही चले आ रहे हैं। सो उनको मुझसे बातचीत करने का अवसर न दे कर उनके यहाँ पहुँचने के पूर्व ही, यहां से हमें अन्यत्र ले चलो, जिससे वे हमें देख भी न पावें

verses.sloka: जितवन्तम् कृतार्थम् हि तदा अहम् अचिराद् इमम् ।कर्म हि अनेन कर्तव्यम् महत् अन्यैः सुदुष्करम् ॥३-५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: jitavantam kṛtārtham hi tadā aham acirād imam ।karma hi anena kartavyam mahat anyaiḥ suduṣkaram ॥3-5-23॥

translations.english: Here comes Rama. Before he talks to me, take me to some other place from where he may not be able to see me. He has to do a great task which is difficult for others. I can see him when he accomplishes the taste and emerges victorious.
translations.hindi: अभी इनको ऐसा बड़ा दुष्कर काये करना हे, जो दूसरों से हो ही नहीं सकता । जब यह थोड़े दिनों बाद राक्षसा को जीत कर कृतकार्य होगें, तब में इनके दर्शन करूंगा । उस कार्य को कर चुकने पर ही यह सुझे देख सकेंगे। तदनन्तर इन्द्र, महर्षि शरभङ्ग से बिदा माँग और उनका विशेष सम्मान कर, घोड़े जुते हुए रथ में बैठे स्वर्ग को चले गए। इन्द्र के जाने के बाद, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी सीता और लक्ष्मण सहित

verses.sloka: अथ वज्री तम् आमंत्र्य मानयित्वा च तापसम् ।रथेन हय युक्तेन ययौ दिवम् अरिन्दमः ॥३-५-२४॥
verses.transliteration: atha vajrī tam āmaṁtrya mānayitvā ca tāpasam ।rathena haya yuktena yayau divam arindamaḥ ॥3-5-24॥

translations.english: This way honouring the sage Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, took leave of him and went to heaven in his chariot harressed with horses.

verses.sloka: प्रयाते तु सहस्राक्षे राघवः सपरिच्छदः ।अग्नि होत्रम् उपासीनम् शरभंगम् उपागमत् ॥३-५-२५॥
verses.transliteration: prayāte tu sahasrākṣe rāghavaḥ saparicchadaḥ ।agni hotram upāsīnam śarabhaṁgam upāgamat ॥3-5-25॥

translations.english: When Indra departed like that, Rama with his retinue (Sita and Lakshmana) went to Sarabhanga who was sitting by the side of the firealtar (for Agnihotra).

verses.sloka: तस्य पादौ च संगृह्य रामः सीता च लक्ष्मणः ।निषेदुः तद् अनुज्ञाता लब्ध वासा निमंत्रिताः ॥३-५-२६॥
verses.transliteration: tasya pādau ca saṁgṛhya rāmaḥ sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ ।niṣeduḥ tad anujñātā labdha vāsā nimaṁtritāḥ ॥3-5-26॥

translations.english: Rama, Sita and Lakshmana prostrated at Sarabhanga's feet. After being permitted to sit, they were invited to stay there.
translations.hindi: अमिहोत्र में बैठे हुए शरभङ्ग जी के पास गए ओर श्रीरामचन्द्र सीता तथा लक्ष्मण ने उनके चरण छुए

verses.sloka: ततः शक्र उपयानम् तु पर्यपृच्छत राघवः ।शरभंगः च तत् सर्वम् राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ॥३-५-२७॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śakra upayānam tu paryapṛcchata rāghavaḥ ।śarabhaṁgaḥ ca tat sarvam rāghavāya nyavedayat ॥3-5-27॥

translations.english: Thereafter on Rama's query Sarabhanga told him all about Indra's visit:

verses.sloka: माम् एष वरदो राम ब्रह्म लोकम् निनीषति ।जितम् उग्रेण तपसा दुष्प्रापम् अकृत आत्मभिः ॥३-५-२८॥
verses.transliteration: mām eṣa varado rāma brahma lokam ninīṣati ।jitam ugreṇa tapasā duṣprāpam akṛta ātmabhiḥ ॥3-5-28॥

translations.english: O Rama, Indra, the bestower of boons, wants to take me to the world of Brahma, earned by me through severe penance which is most difficult to be attained by those devoid of selfrealisation.
translations.hindi: शरभङ्ग ने सब वृत्तान्त कह सुनाया । ( शरभङ्ग ने कद्दा ) हद राम ! यह वरदाता इन्द्र मुझे ब्रह्मलोक में ले जाने के लिए आए थे

verses.sloka: अहम् ज्ञात्वा नर व्याघ्र वर्तमानम् अदूरतः ।ब्रह्म लोकम् न गच्छामि त्वाम् अदृष्ट्वा प्रिय अतिथिम् ॥३-५-२९॥
verses.transliteration: aham jñātvā nara vyāghra vartamānam adūrataḥ ।brahma lokam na gacchāmi tvām adṛṣṭvā priya atithim ॥3-5-29॥

translations.english: O Rama, the best among men you are a very dear guest to me and knowing that you are near, I will not go to the world of Brahman without seeing you.

verses.sloka: त्वया अहम् पुरुषव्याघ्र धार्मिकेण महत्मनाअ ।समागम्य गमिष्यामि त्रिदिवम् च अवरम् परम् ॥३-५-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā aham puruṣavyāghra dhārmikeṇa mahatmanāa ।samāgamya gamiṣyāmi tridivam ca avaram param ॥3-5-30॥

translations.english: O Rama, the best of men (only) after seeing a great, virtuous soul like you shall I go to heaven, the abode of the gods.
translations.hindi: अतः तुम सरीखे प्रिय अतिथि के दर्शन किए विना, मुके ब्रह्म- लोक वा अभीष्ट नहीं हे! हे पुरुषसिंह ! अब तुम जैसे धम- निष्ठ और महात्मा से मिल भेंट कर, में स्वर्ग या ब्रह्मलोक को चला जाऊंगा । हे नरशादूं न ! मैंने तपःप्रभाव से जिन अक्षय्य और रम्य लोकों क्क अधिकार प्राप्त कर रखा है

verses.sloka: अक्षया नर शार्दूल जितालोका मया शुभाः ।ब्राह्म्याः च नाक पृष्ठ्याः च प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मामकान् ॥३-५-३१॥
verses.transliteration: akṣayā nara śārdūla jitālokā mayā śubhāḥ ।brāhmyāḥ ca nāka pṛṣṭhyāḥ ca pratigṛhṇīṣva māmakān ॥3-5-31॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, I have conquered heavenly abodes as well as the imperishable, auspicious worlds of Brahma. Accept them all that are mine (obtained through my penance)

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तो नरव्याघ्रः सर्व शास्त्र विशारदः ।ऋषिणा शरभंगेन राघवो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-५-३२॥
verses.transliteration: evam ukto naravyāghraḥ sarva śāstra viśāradaḥ ।ṛṣiṇā śarabhaṁgena rāghavo vākyam abravīt ॥3-5-32॥

translations.english: To these words of sage Sarabhanga Rama, the best of men, the knower of all sastras, the scion of the Raghus replied:
translations.hindi: सो उन ब्रह्मलोक और स्वर्ग की प्राप्ति के साधन रूप 'उप:फल को. में आपको समर्थित करता हूँ। आप ग्रहण करें । महर्षि शरभङ्ग जी के ऐसा कहने पर और शरभङ्ग के समर्पित तपःफल का लेना अस्वीकृत कर सब शाख्रों के जानने वाले पुरुषसिह्‌ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी शरभङ्ग ऋषि से बोले--हे महामुने ! में स्त्रयं ही छन सब लोकों को प्राप्त करूंगा

verses.sloka: अहम् एव आहरिष्यामि सर्वान् लोकान् महामुने ।आवासम् तु अहम् इच्छामि प्रदिष्टम् इह कानने ॥३-५-३३॥
verses.transliteration: aham eva āhariṣyāmi sarvān lokān mahāmune ।āvāsam tu aham icchāmi pradiṣṭam iha kānane ॥3-5-33॥

translations.english: O great sage, I will earn all the worlds myself if you direct me. But I need a proper dwellingplace in this forest.

verses.sloka: राघवेण एवम् उक्तः तु शक्र तुल्य बलेन वै ।शरभंगो महाप्राज्ञः पुनर् एव अब्रवीत् वचः ॥३-५-३४॥
verses.transliteration: rāghaveṇa evam uktaḥ tu śakra tulya balena vai ।śarabhaṁgo mahāprājñaḥ punar eva abravīt vacaḥ ॥3-5-34॥

translations.english: To this request of Rama who was equal to Indra in strength, sagacious Sarabhanga said these words:
translations.hindi: मैं तो इस वन में, रहता चाहता हूँ । आप मुझे रहने के लिए | स्थान बतलाइए । इन्द्र के समान बलवान्‌ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने जब इस प्रकार कहा

verses.sloka: इह राम महातेजाः सुतीक्ष्णो नम धार्मिकः ।वसति अरण्ये नियतः स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति ॥३-५-३५॥
verses.transliteration: iha rāma mahātejāḥ sutīkṣṇo nama dhārmikaḥ ।vasati araṇye niyataḥ sa te śreyo vidhāsyati ॥3-5-35॥

translations.english: Here dwells in this forest a brilliant saint, righteous and selfcontrolled, Sutikshna by name who will look to your welfare, O Rama

verses.sloka: सुतीक्ष्णम् अभिगच्छ त्वम् शुचौ देशे तपस्विनम् ।रमणीये वनोद्देशे स ते वासम् विधास्यति ॥३-५-३६॥
verses.transliteration: sutīkṣṇam abhigaccha tvam śucau deśe tapasvinam ।ramaṇīye vanoddeśe sa te vāsam vidhāsyati ॥3-5-36॥

translations.english: You may approach sage, Sutikshna residing in a sacred spot. He will provide you a delightful place for your stay in the forest.
translations.hindi: हे तात! सप जिस प्रकार पुरानी केंचली, छोड़ता हे, उसी प्रकार में भी इस समय यह. पुरानी देह छोड़ना चाहता हूँ । ऐसा कह मंत्रवेत्ता शरभङ्ग मुनि अग्नि को स्थापन कर ओर उसमें घी की आहुति दे, अझ्नि में कूद पड़े । उस समय अभ्नि ने उन महात्मा के रोम, केश, जीणत्वचा, हड़ियाँ और रुधिर सहित माँस को, भस्म कर डाला । भाई लक्ष्मण ओर भार्या सीता सहित श्रीराम चन्द्र को, यह देख विस्मय हुआ कि,

verses.sloka: इमाम् मन्दाकिनीम् राम प्रतिस्रोतम् अनुव्रज ।नदीम् पुष्पोडुप वहाम् ततः तत्र गमिष्यसि ॥३-५-३७॥
verses.transliteration: imām mandākinīm rāma pratisrotam anuvraja ।nadīm puṣpoḍupa vahām tataḥ tatra gamiṣyasi ॥3-5-37॥

translations.english: Proceed, O Rama in the reverse direction of the river Mandakini carrying flowers and floats. And you will reach the place.

verses.sloka: एष पन्था नरव्याघ्र मुहूर्तम् पश्य तात माम् ।यावत् जहामि गात्राणि जीर्णाम् त्वचम् इव उरगः ॥३-५-३८॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa panthā naravyāghra muhūrtam paśya tāta mām ।yāvat jahāmi gātrāṇi jīrṇām tvacam iva uragaḥ ॥3-5-38॥

translations.english: O Rama, the best among men, this is the way. Look at me for a while, my dear, until I shed my limbs just as a snake sheds its withered slough.
translations.hindi: हे तात ! देखो, इस नदी में अनेक वड़े बड़े फूल छोटी छोटी नावों की तरह बहते देख पड़ते हें । इनको देखते हुए, तुम चले जाओ । मैंने तुमको रास्ता बता दिआ, किन्तु दो घड़ी मेरी ओर तुम देखते रहो

verses.sloka: ततो अग्निम् सु समाधाय हुत्वा च आज्येन मंत्रवित् ।शरभंगो महातेजाः प्रविवेश हुताशनम् ॥३-५-३९॥
verses.transliteration: tato agnim su samādhāya hutvā ca ājyena maṁtravit ।śarabhaṁgo mahātejāḥ praviveśa hutāśanam ॥3-5-39॥

translations.english: Then the effulgent Sarabhanga, knower of mantras (magical spells) kindled the fire with faggots and after offering oblations of ghee plunged in.

verses.sloka: तस्य रोमाणि केशाम् च तदा वह्निः महात्मनः ।जीर्णम् त्वचम् तद् अस्थीनि यत् च मांसम् च शोणितम् ॥३-५-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tasya romāṇi keśām ca tadā vahniḥ mahātmanaḥ ।jīrṇam tvacam tad asthīni yat ca māṁsam ca śoṇitam ॥3-5-40॥

translations.english: Then were consumed that highsouled Sarabhanga's hair on the body and on the head, the wornout skin, the bones and flesh along with blood.

verses.sloka: स च पावक संकाशः कुमारः समपद्यत ।उत्थाय अग्निचयात् तस्मात् शरभंगो व्यरोचत ॥३-५-४१॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca pāvaka saṁkāśaḥ kumāraḥ samapadyata ।utthāya agnicayāt tasmāt śarabhaṁgo vyarocata ॥3-5-41॥

translations.english: Sarabhanga then emerged youthful from that heap of fire, shining like a flame and looking very elegant৷৷

verses.sloka: स लोकान् आहिताग्नीनाम् ऋषीणाम् च महात्मनाम् ।देवानाम् च व्यतिक्रम्य ब्रह्म लोकम् व्यरोहत ॥३-५-४२॥
verses.transliteration: sa lokān āhitāgnīnām ṛṣīṇām ca mahātmanām ।devānām ca vyatikramya brahma lokam vyarohata ॥3-5-42॥

translations.english: Sarabhanga then went beyond the worlds of the gods, of the great sages who constantly kindle sacrificial fire, and ascended to the world of Brahman.
translations.hindi: उस अमि में से शरभङ्ग जी अग्नि तुल्य कान्तिमान्‌ एक कुमार का रूप धारण कर निकले और शोभायमान हुए

verses.sloka: स पुण्य कर्मा भुवने द्विजर्षभःपितामहम् सानुचरम् ददर्श ह ।पितामहः च अपि समीक्ष्य तम् द्विजम्ननन्द सुस्वागतम् इति उवाच ह  ॥३-५-४३॥
verses.transliteration: sa puṇya karmā bhuvane dvijarṣabhaḥpitāmaham sānucaram dadarśa ha ।pitāmahaḥ ca api samīkṣya tam dvijamnananda susvāgatam iti uvāca ha  ॥3-5-43॥

translations.english: Sarabhanga, performer of sacred deeds, saw Brahma with his followers৷৷ Brahma also seeing Sarabhanga, the best among the brahmins, welcomed him gladly. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: तद्नन्तर शरभङ्ग जो अग्निहोत्रियों, ऋषियों, महात्माओं और देवताओं के लोकों को पीछे छोड़ते हुए, नरह्मलोक में जा पहुँचे
